description_target.ambiguity_notes: The first all-zero row determines template height and separates the header from the layout. Row-0 nonzero runs are filtered into non-gray swatches and gray template bounds; the two filtered lists are paired by left-to-right order, so swatch run width is irrelevant. The nonzero layout bounding box must be dense because color 0 has no template mapping.
negative_constraints: Do not pair swatches and masks by spatial proximity or by swatch run width.
Do not copy gray into the output; gray mask cells become the selected layout color.
Do not preserve header, separator, padding, or layout pixels in their original scale.
Do not use a layout color that lacks an ordered swatch/template mapping.
solution_steps: Find the first all-zero row; its index is the common template height and it ends the header.
Scan row 0 into nonzero runs, retaining non-gray runs as ordered swatch colors and gray runs as ordered template bounds.
Extract each gray template matrix over all header rows and pair it with the swatch at the same list position.
Crop the lower nonzero layout to its bounding rectangle.
Replace each layout cell by its paired template, mapping gray cells to the layout color and every other template cell to zero.
description_target.target_text: Use the first all-zero row to split the header from the lower dense layout. Pair the left-to-right non-gray row-0 swatch runs with the left-to-right gray template runs. Expand each cell of the cropped layout into its paired gray mask, recoloring gray mask cells to that layout color and emitting zero elsewhere.
